payload.label: 3D FRAME ANALYSIS
payload.disclaimer: Linear elastic 3D frame analysis with the internal SAIA solver. Seismic loads follow Standard 2800 (4th ed.) as implemented here (equivalent static + response spectrum, simplifications listed under Assumptions). Not a certified code check; final engineering decisions require verification by a qualified engineer.
payload.code: Analysis with Standard 2800 (4th ed.) seismic loads; Mabhas 9 RC design (simplified, see clauses)
detailing_assumptions: Allowed beam bars Φ: Φ14, Φ16, Φ18, Φ20, Φ22, Φ25 mm
Allowed column bars Φ: Φ16, Φ18, Φ20, Φ22, Φ25, Φ28 mm
Footing bar diameters: Φ14, Φ16, Φ18, Φ20, Φ22, Φ25 mm

seismic.vertical_distribution: F_i = V·W_i·h_i^k / Σ W_j·h_j^k (4th ed.; replaces the 3rd-ed. Ft)

modal.method: Modal (condensed diaphragm DOFs, numpy eigh) + Standard 2800 design spectrum A·B·I/R, CQC (5% damping), 5% accidental torsion

p_delta.rule: auto: P-Δ is included for IRAN_2800 projects when the storey stability index θ = Pu·Δe/(V·h) exceeds 0.1 (Standard 2800 4th ed. §3-6, eq. 3-12); on = always; off = never (θ is still reported)
p_delta.basis: Second-order elastic analysis: K + K_G with member axial forces frozen from 1.2D+1.0L (linear geometric stiffness of each beam-column)

rs_design.note: RS member forces: CQC, 5 % damping, 5 % accidental torsion, scaled to ≥ 85 % (regular) / 90 % (irregular) of V_static

design.scwb_note: ΣMnc ≥ 1.2·ΣMnb (reported as a check; verify applicability for this ductility level)
clauses_implemented: Material factors φc = 0.65, φs = 0.85; εcu = 0.0035; α1, β1 stress block
Beam flexure: required As, As,min = max(0.25√f'c, 1.4)·b·d/fy, ρ ≤ 0.025, c/d ≤ 700/(700+fy)
Beam M⁺ ≥ M⁻/3 at the face (intermediate) / ≥ M⁻/2 (special)
Beam shear: Vc = 0.2·φc·√f'c·b·d, Vs = φs·Av·fy·d/s, Av,min, spacing limits incl. end zones 2h
Column P–M interaction by strain compatibility, Pr,max = 0.8·Pr0, ρ between 1 % and 6 %
Column ties: s0 = min(8db, 24dt, b/2, 300) over l0 = max(h, Ln/6, 450); elsewhere min(16db, 48dt, b)
Strong column / weak beam: ΣMnc ≥ 1.2·ΣMnb (nominal capacities)
Practical detailing rule: longitudinal column bars at ≤ 200 mm, bars in one layer with clear spacing ≥ max(db, 25 mm)
clauses_simplified: Biaxial bending by linear load contour Mux/Mrx + Muy/Mry ≤ 1 (conservative Bresler α = 1)
Beam/column shear from the analysis envelope; capacity-design shear (Mpr / 2E) not applied
Section limit Vs ≤ 4·Vc used for the maximum shear reinforcement
Moments at member centre-lines (not at support faces); no redistribution

Not checked: column shear, member slenderness (local P-δ magnification; global P-Δ is in the analysis only when applied), beam-column joint shear, confinement Ash, development/splices, crack/deflection
design.analysis_basis: Member forces: envelope of the equivalent static load cases and the response-spectrum (CQC, scaled to the minimum dynamic base shear, ±5% accidental torsion) load cases; first-order analysis (P-Δ not included)

assumptions: Regular orthogonal grid, fixed column bases, rigid floor diaphragms
Cracked stiffness: beams 0.35·Ig, columns 0.70·Ig; torsion 0.15·J; Ec = 4700√f'c
Two-way slab loads to beams by equivalent triangular/trapezoidal UDL; slab self-weight is part of the dead load
Perimeter wall 7 kN/m on edge beams, roof parapet 2 kN/m; roof live load 1.5 kN/m²
Combinations: 1.4D, 1.2D+1.6L, 1.2D+1.0L±E, 0.9D±E (Mabhas 6 / ACI form; no 30% orthogonal combination)
P-Δ not included: stability index θ < 0.1 (Standard 2800 §3-6 allows ignoring it)
Standard 2800 (4th ed.) equivalent static with the empirical period T = 0.05·H^0.75 = 0.400 s (analytical period not used for C)
Inelastic drift Δm = Cd·Δe/I (Cd/I = 4.5/1), limit 2% ; drift from the design-force analysis (conservative)
Modal analysis on rigid-diaphragm DOFs with storey masses (D+0.2L)/g and uniform-plate polar inertia; mass centre at plan centre
Response spectrum: 2800 design spectrum A·B1·N·I/R, CQC 5% damping, 5% accidental torsion in the dynamic cases
Dynamic results scaled so V_dynamic ≥ 85% (regular) / 90% (irregular) of V_static; scaled response-spectrum member forces are enveloped with the static ones in design
Foundation: isolated square footings under every base column; reactions of the analysis combinations; allowable bearing 150 kPa (assumed)
warnings: Strong column / weak beam ratio below 1.2 at some joints (see design table): consider larger columns or less beam steel.
Allowable soil bearing was not given and 150 kPa is assumed (add e.g. 'allowable bearing 200 kPa' / 'تنش مجاز خاک 200 kPa').

exports.label: ETABS model (.e2k)
notes: Not yet opened in a licensed ETABS: syntax copied from public ETABS 2016/21 exports, import not confirmed.
Seismic EX/EY use DIR "X"/"Y" without the ±5% accidental eccentricity (our analysis includes it); set 'X + Ecc. Y' in ETABS if you need it.
Mass source = element self mass (columns only; beam MMOD=0 because beam weight is in the line loads) + 1.0·Dead + 0.2·Live loads — check Define > Mass Source after import.
Slabs are not modelled as shells: floor loads are already distributed to beams as line loads (tributary areas).

exports.label: SAFE foundation loads (.f2k)
notes: When a foundation design exists the placeholder mat is replaced by one footing area per column (sizes/thickness from the design); soil spring ks is still a placeholder.
Point table, load patterns/cases/combinations and point loads follow an ETABS→SAFE 2014 export (SAFE v12–2016 table names).

The mat outline tables (MATERIAL PROPERTIES 0x, SLAB PROPERTIES 01, SOIL PROPERTIES, OBJECT GEOMETRY - AREAS 01, SLAB/SOIL PROPERTY ASSIGNMENTS) are written from memory of the SAFE 12 format and are a PLACEHOLDER — delete them if SAFE rejects the file and draw the mat/footings in SAFE.

exports.label: SAP2000 model (.s2k)
notes: Not yet opened in a licensed SAP2000 (cannot run on our Linux server): table/field names follow the SAP2000 v14-v24 $2k database format; use File > Import > SAP2000 .s2k and check the import log.

Seismic EX/EY are written as AUTO SEISMIC - USER COEFFICIENT (C, K) without accidental eccentricity; if SAP2000 rejects that table delete it and define EX/EY via Define > Load Patterns > User Coefficient.
Floors are rigid diaphragm joint constraints (one per storey); slabs are not shells — floor loads are already beam line loads.
Mass source = element mass (beams MMod=0 because their weight is in the line loads) + 1.0 DEAD + 0.2 LIVE.

notes: DXF R2010 (ezdxf, audited); office drawing standard: A3/A1 paper-space sheets with title block, S-0k story plans, S-10 column/beam schedules, S-F1 foundation plan + footing schedule, E-xx elevations per grid line; units mm.

exports.label: Rebar detailing sheets + bar bending schedule (.dxf)
notes: DXF R2010 (ezdxf, audited); sheets R-01 beams, R-02 columns, R-03 bar bending schedule; units mm.
Detailing rules marked [code] / [assumed] on sheet R-03; engineer review required before construction.

exports.label: Foundation plan, footing sections + bending schedule (.dxf)
notes: DXF R2010 (ezdxf, audited); FD-01 footing plan + schedule, FD-02 sections per footing type + bending schedule; units mm.
Footings designed to Mabhas 9 (flexure at the column face, one-way and punching shear); cover/Df/lean concrete changeable from chat.

clauses_implemented: Service bearing: q = P/A·(1 + 6ex/B + 6ey/B) ≤ qa,net, kern check ex + ey ≤ B/6 (no uplift)
Net allowable pressure qa,net = qa − γ·Df with Df = 1.5 m, γ = 18 kN/m³; qa × 1.33 for combinations with earthquake
One-way shear at d from the column face: Vc = 0.2·φc·√f'c·b·d
Punching shear on bo at d/2: vc = φc·√f'c·min(0.2(1+2/βc), 0.2(αs·d/bo + 2), 0.4)
Flexure at the column face with the Mabhas 9 stress block (φc = 0.65, φs = 0.85), As,min = 0.0018·b·h
clauses_simplified: Square pad footings, one per base column, centred under the column; uniform soil, rigid footing
Eccentricity from the base reactions (M + V·h); footing self-weight and soil are deducted from qa through Df
Group size = envelope of the columns of the same position (corner / edge / interior) at the base
Not checked: settlement, sliding, overturning, bearing capacity from soil data, development length, column dowels, bearing on the column base
